extraction: verification-loop defines 4-phase verification for each engine build: Phase 1 - Lint/typecheck (ruff, mypy, biome); Phase 2 - Unit tests (pytest, 80% coverage); Phase 3 - Integration tests (engine on 200-dpi citizen docs); Phase 4 - Regression check (LEADERBOARD.md CER delta < 0.5%). Each phase gates next. Maps to our 18-lang OCR goal: Phase 3 catches regressions on weak cells (OldScan 55.3, Odia 80.01) before Verdict sees results.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether verification-loop becomes mandatory gate for every Engine output before Verdict review
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
